messages:
oliver: heads up — CI perf job (serving-e2e-latency) spiked after merge of #8427. ~18% p95 decode increase. CI run: https://ci.internal/redwood/7890
perf-bot: Performance alert: serving-e2e-latency p95 +18% vs baseline on commit 3f4a6c. Automated diff attached.
sophia: can someone repro locally? timestamped artifacts would help.
raj: repro'd on my devbox with seq_len=2048, batch=1. profiler shows kernel_selector picked generic_attn instead of fused_qKV path.
raj: profiler snippet:
```
kernel_select(ms): fused_qkv -> 0.8, generic_attn -> 5.6
selection_path: heuristics_v2 (seq=2048) -> picked generic_attn
```
miguel: bisect -> commit 3f4a6c (PR #8409). that PR adjusted fused-op thresholds & introduced heuristics_v2.
jessica: if that's true we should either revert or patch quickly. rollout blocked until perf clears.
oliver: putting the rollout on hold, tagging #release-team. please nominate a rollback if needed.
raj: quick fix idea: relax heuristic boundary back up. change threshold from 1536 -> 2048 in fused_selector and add regression test for seq_len boundary.
raj: proposed patch snippet:
```
// heuristics_v2 tweak
if (seq_len >= 2048 && device == GPU_A) choose_fused_qkv();
```
sophia: also noticed KV cache miss-rate jumped ~12% in the same failing run. sample from serving logs:
```
kv_cache: normalized_key_miss_ratio=0.12 old=0.00 new=0.12
reason: key_normalization introduced in PR #8409 changed canonicalization of batched keys
```
miguel: that aligns with a tiny change I made to cache key canonicalization in the PR. it appears to break some prefix matches for batched requests. I'll take the cache bit.
ci-bot: queued perf-e2e job: https://ci.internal/redwood/7895 (runs with rollback candidate branch).
jessica: agree split fixes: immediate rollback for kernel heuristics to restore latency, separate PR for cache canonicalization. i'll file rollback PR.
oliver: who will own the rollback and the follow-up?
jessica: assigning kernel rollback to raj, cache revert + investigation to miguel. tagging @release-team for visibility.
raj: pushing rollback PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/8415 — includes unit test + microbench.
raj: local microbench p95 back to baseline: 120ms -> 102ms after rollback.
perf-bot: waiting for CI to confirm. marking alert as pending resolution.
ci-bot: perf-e2e result: FAIL (p95 +2%). may be within noise; collecting more runs. https://ci.internal/redwood/7896
sophia: two follow-ups: 1) add deterministic perf unit that sweeps seq_len [512,1024,1536,2048,4096] and batch sizes, 2) add telemetry events in kernel-selector so we can see which kernel chosen per request in prod.
oliver: agreed. hold rollout until green + perf telemetry in place. :lock:
miguel: i'll open a KB entry for ops about temporary fallback behavior and how to trigger manual revert if needed.
jessica: created postmortem stub and linked rollback PRs. we'll reconcile after CI stabilizes. :white_check_mark:
